name: Falklands, South Georgia and Antarctica

seo.title: Falklands, South Georgia and Antarctica: 20 Days
seo.description: Antarctica21's grand sea voyage from Punta Arenas: the Falklands, South Georgia's king penguins, Elephant Island and the Antarctic Peninsula, ending in Ushuaia.

tagline: Twenty days through the whole South Atlantic arc.
answer: Falklands (Malvinas), South Georgia and Antarctica is Antarctica21's twenty-day, nineteen-night sea voyage from Punta Arenas to Ushuaia. It calls at Saunders, West Point and Port Stanley, spends four days at South Georgia, passes Elephant Island and gives four days to the Peninsula. It sails in September and October with up to 96 guests.
overview: A full sea voyage with no flight. It links the Falklands, South Georgia and the Antarctic Peninsula in one southbound sweep.

gallery.alt: Two albatrosses with white heads and black backs resting close together

itinerary.title: Punta Arenas
itinerary.summary: Group transfer from Explorers House to the ship; introductory talk on the Strait of Magellan.

itinerary.title: Saunders and West Point Islands
itinerary.summary: Rockhopper and gentoo penguins and black browed albatross; optional hike and a Falklands tea.

itinerary.title: Port Stanley
itinerary.summary: Guided walk or time on your own in town.

itinerary.title: Elsehul Bay
itinerary.summary: Evening Zodiac cruise, subject to the crossing and permits.

itinerary.title: Salisbury Plain and Possession Bay
itinerary.summary: King penguins; Zodiac cruise or nearby visits.

itinerary.title: Grytviken, Fortuna Bay and Stromness
itinerary.summary: Whaling station, museum and Shackleton's grave; king penguins; optional Shackleton walk.

itinerary.title: St Andrews Bay and Drygalski Fjord
itinerary.summary: Large king penguin colony and elephant seals; fjord cruise if the weather allows.

itinerary.title: Elephant Island
itinerary.summary: Seen from the ship or a Zodiac; landing unlikely.

itinerary.title: Antarctic Peninsula and South Shetland Islands
itinerary.summary: Possible sites include Brown Bluff, Half Moon Island, Deception Island and Cuverville Island.
itinerary.label: Days 14 to 17

inclusions: Access to Explorers House in Punta Arenas
Guided shore excursions, lectures and onboard entertainment
Buffet breakfast and lunch, a la carte dinner, selected drinks and snacks
Loan of waterproof boots, contingency plan and the IAATO passenger fee
children: Sea voyages: minimum age 12, per Antarctica21's travel tips FAQ.
faqs: Is there a flight on this voyage?
No. It sails both ways, from Punta Arenas to Ushuaia.
Antarctica21's page says this voyage is not currently open for booking.
